title: Exothermic and Endothermic Reactions
text: Chemical reactions either release or absorb energy, typically as heat. Exothermic reactions release energy to their surroundings, causing a temperature increase (e.g., combustion, respiration). Endothermic reactions absorb energy from their surroundings, causing a temperature decrease (e.g., photosynthesis, melting ice). The classification depends on whether the total energy of the products is lower (exothermic) or higher (endothermic) than that of the reactants.
